# O.G. Nails by Olga

> Nail studio in Ballantyne, Charlotte, North Carolina, run by nail specialist Olga Glavatcaia. Advanced dry (Russian / e-file) manicures, dry pedicures, advanced pedicure and foot care (cracked heels, calluses, corns, thick toenails, titanium wire correction for early ingrown toenails) and hard gel extensions. Appointments are one-on-one and booked online through Vagaro.

## Key facts
- Address: 5107 Piper Station Dr, Suite C, Charlotte, NC 28277 (Ballantyne), inside SES Style Salon
- Serves: Ballantyne, Charlotte, Pineville, SouthPark, Weddington, Matthews and Marvin
- Booking: https://www.vagaro.com/ognails (by appointment only)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/o.g_nails
- Specialist: Olga Glavatcaia, nail specialist since 2017, NailPro World Cup 2020 3rd place, trained in titanium wire toenail correction (2026)
- Services for women and men
- We do not diagnose or treat fungal infections. If a medical condition is suspected, we recommend consulting a podiatrist.

## Prices (USD)
### Dry manicure
- Hygienic Manicure (No Polish): $70. Nail trimming and shaping, cuticle care with the e-file (dry) technique and a soothing hand massage, leaving your hands refreshed and rejuvenated.
- Hygienic Manicure for Men (No Polish): $95. Nail trimming and shaping, cuticle care with the e-file (dry) technique and a soothing hand massage, leaving your hands refreshed and rejuvenated.
- Manicure with Gel Polish / Strengthening: $120. Nail shaping and cuticle care with the e-file (dry) technique, followed by a strengthening base coat and a high-quality gel polish. Designed to resist chipping and give natural nails a beautiful, polished look.
- Hand Spa Treatment: $30. A rejuvenating treatment to nourish and revitalize your hands: gentle exfoliation to remove dead skin cells, a 10-minute paraffin mask and a soothing massage with professional Gehwol hand cream.
- Design / French: from $20. Nail art or a French finish, added to any polish service.

### Dry pedicure & advanced foot care
- Hygienic Pedicure (No Polish): $110. Nail trimming, cuticle care and exfoliation of the feet with the e-file (dry) technique, followed by a soothing foot massage with professional Gehwol foot cream.
- Hygienic Pedicure for Men (No Polish): $120. Nail trimming, cuticle care and exfoliation of the feet with the e-file (dry) technique, followed by a soothing foot massage with professional Gehwol foot cream.
- Pedicure with Gel Polish / French: $140. A polished look with a long-lasting gel finish that resists chipping and fading. The high-gloss shine enhances the natural beauty of your feet.
- Advanced Pedicure / Foot Care (No Polish): $160–$260. Addresses keratoses, cracks, excessive dryness and calluses. Price is based on the complexity of the case, in three levels: basic, moderate and complex. Complexity depends on the condition of the foot, not the nails.
- Deep Toenail Cleaning: $10–$30 per nail. Thorough cleaning of toenails affected by hematoma, fungus or onycholysis. Available as an add-on to the Advanced Pedicure only.
- Advanced Pedicure / Foot Care with Gel Polish: $180–$280. An advanced treatment to smooth keratoses, treat cracked skin and restore moisture to very dry feet, finished with gel polish for a long-lasting, flawless look that resists chipping and fading. Gel polish is applied only when the natural nail plate is healthy and suitable.

### Hard gel & extensions
- Gel Fill: Short Nails: $140. Detailed cuticle care with the e-file (dry) technique for precision and cleanliness, finished with hard gel shaping on your short nails for a durable, smooth and polished result.
- Gel Fill: Medium Nails: $160. Meticulous cuticle care with the e-file (dry) technique, finished with expertly shaped hard gel on your medium-length nails for a long-lasting, smooth and polished look.
- Gel Fill: Long Nails: $180. Detailed cuticle care with the e-file (dry) technique, finished by shaping your long nails with high-quality hard gel for a durable, smooth and polished result.
- Nail Extension: Short / Medium: from $190. Extensions for longer, more elegant nails, built to your desired short or medium length and shape.
- Nail Extension: Long: from $250. Extensions to achieve your desired long length, with personalized designs that reflect your style for nails that look elegant and unique.
- Design / French: from $20. Nail art or a French finish, added to any gel service.
- Sculpted Design / French: from $250. Custom sculpted nail shapes with elegant designs or French tips, created with durable hard gel for a unique, long-lasting finish that reflects your personal style.
